podcast.body: An instrumental track from Side 2 of the album "Low," "Warzawa" exemplified Bowie's experimental direction at the time. Initially perceived as radically avant-garde, it is now recognized as a visionary piece that helped spread the idea of synthesizer music. "This is an instrumental track called Warzawa."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This track was composed by Brian Eno using his portable EMS AKS synthesizer while Bowie was at a trial in Paris. It made a great impression on Bowie and became the opening track of the B-side of the *Low* album, contributing to its atmospheric, desolate, and sci-fi soundtrack-like quality. "La pista causó una gran impresión en Bowie y sería el tema que abriría la carave."
